> [!WARNING]
> **No longer maintained.** 1.x gets no updates any more. Switch to `:2` — see [Drop 2.0](https://github.com/dropnook/drop/releases/tag/v2.0.0).

**Drop 1.0** — instant sharing for your home network, like AirDrop for every device.

* Text fields and files, live on every device, in the browser: no app, no login, no cloud.
* Screenshots with Ctrl+V; pictures with a preview, a large view and *Copy*.
* Share links that expire, optionally with a password, from a separate, locked-down container.
* 17 languages, light and dark.
